title: RuntimeException: Cannot find preference screen within search result
symptom: Searching the settings for "back-fill" and clicking on the top-most hit "Back-fill data Tap to send historical data to Nightscout" results in a java.lang.RuntimeException: Cannot find preference screen within search result. The log shows an error trying to highlight search results.
cause: The bug is traced to the library search-preference.aar, which is self-compiled from ByteHamster/SearchPreference and modified around version v1.2.6. The issue is likely due to missing android:key attributes on some preference screens.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit referenced by jamorham: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/87ac6fc1f57ac40d89f79fa77a6daa13e8379074. Additionally, a pull request #2114 with more fixes was opened.
evidence_quote: This is easy to resolve see: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/87ac6fc1f57ac40d89f79fa77a6daa13e8379074
